acceptanceCriteria: The owner decides whether a /0 step-negation join (LPCV-V0-068) must also bind helper and support files, or records the spec+config-digest binding as an accepted limitation.
Before `stepNegationJoinQualified` is enabled, a test shows a changed helper file either breaks the /0 join or is reported as an unbound input.
The `negate-provider-failed` refusal code is owned by a numbered requirement.
body:
Found by the V1-1024 lane (step-level negative controls, LPCV-V0-057..070, branch claude/v1-1024-negative-controls head 35ba7588, base origin/main 388fb832, build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-08-v1-1024-negative-controls.md), Codex review P2 kept open.

Expected: a step-negation strength join cannot attach to a test whose inputs changed since the negate run.
Actual: a /0 join is bound only by the spec and config file digests, as LPCV-V0-068 states, so a changed helper file does not break a /0 join. Refusing /0 joins would drop them, which the requirement includes, so this needs an intent decision. The join is currently off (`stepNegationJoinQualified = false`) and LPCV-V0-070 qualification is NOT_RUN.

Also: the core emits refusal code `negate-provider-failed`, which no numbered requirement owns yet (named only in the traceability row for the error-code gate).
title: step-negation /0 join binds only spec and config digests; helper changes go unnoticed (LPCV-V0-068)
